Adjacent-backup copy now says backups sit beside the world file and receive no automatic cleanup.
Russian save-failure copy now states that the world remains unchanged.
The two Source overwrite rows retain exact decoded Source text, including Source German grammar.
Existing Source captions come from independent captured Source action and status catalogs.
Expected status strings retain exact branch order, int64 decimal text, raw diagnostics, recovery warning paths, and variable directory path.
The test reads this independent JSON and never loads MainLabels.
